scope: Independent scalar recomputation from sealed source instance metadata, not raw assets. No import or AST execution of A nominal_instance/query_join/footprint or V74 ordering functions.
fixed_geometry: Literal V74 fixed Z-up signs times [400,600,72]mm, center0. Analytic vertical normals [-Y,+Y,-X,+X]; max normalized outward camera direction with first-listed exact tie; top worldZ, front top imageX, rear via opposite-axis topology.
camera: Original R/K/t literal values retained. Independent scalar pivoted elimination solves R*c=-t (never transpose approximation or R orthogonalization). Independent scalar dot products p_cam=R*p_model+t; homogeneous K projection.
uncertainty: Preserve original normal-margin<=1e-10 or nonpositive front-top imageX separation role uncertainty, original first-listed tie convention; this is inherited order uncertainty, not a newly tuned threshold.
crop: delta=nominal_ref-original_q; distance=hypot(delta); crop_xy=96*delta/L+47.5; outer[-.5,95.5), sample-center[0,95], source sampler[-.5,W-.5)x[-.5,H-.5) separately. These are numeric diagnostics, never new input/semantic gates.
missing: Preserve null/sentinel/nonfinite q/L, unavailable lookup and invalid geometry cases. A finite reference for nonpositive-Z may have numeric footprint values while lookup remains UNKNOWN; never infer semantic visibility or resurrect inputU.

comparison_tolerances.geometry_error_exception_prose: Only null-vs-present/nonempty is checked on invalid geometry; independent implementations have different exception strings.
